sections.heading: Pricing & payment
sections.text: Payment is accepting via PayPal in USD. Full payment is required after the sketch has been approved. Work on the artwork will continue once the payment has been recived. Additional fees may apply for complex backgrounds, extra characters or other add-ons.

sections.heading: Work process & revisions
sections.text: Work-in-progress updates will be provided throughout the commission process. Revisions are free before the detailing stage. Any changes requested afterward may require an additional fee unless the correction is due to my mistake.

sections.heading: Refund Policy
sections.text: Refunds are not available. The only exception is if I am unable to complete the commission or choose to cancel it myself. In that case, a full refund will be issued.

sections.heading: Client Responsibilities
sections.text: Please provide clear references and instructions. Delays in communication may affect the completion time. I reserve the right to decline any commission request.

sections.heading: Copyright & Usage
sections.text: The artist retains all rights to the artwork unless otherwise agreed upon. Commissioned artwork is intended for personal use only, unless commercial use has been agreed in advance. The finished piece may not be altered, edited, or modified in any way.

sections.heading: Publication & Portfolio
sections.text: I reserve the right to publish the artwork in my portfolio and social media, including watermarked and reduced-quality versions. Any request for delayed publication or non-publication must be communicated in advance.

sections.heading: Deadline & Delivery
sections.text: The estimated deadline for completing a commission is between 1 week and 1 month, depending on complexity and workload. Final artwork is delivered as high-resolution PNG via Google Drive or email.

sections.heading: Artistic Interpretation
sections.text: References will be carefully considered, but the final artwork will be created in the artist's own style. Small stylistic differences may appear depending on the interpretation of the design.

sections.heading: Monetizes Content Use
sections.text:
Monetized use of the artwork is allowed free of charge, including but not limited to YouTube videos, streams, social media content, and other revenue-generating platforms.
Proper and visible credit to the artist is strictly required in all cases where the artwork is used in monetized content. Credit must be clearly displayed in the description, post, or equivalent visible area depending on the platform.
Failure to provide proper attribution may result in withdrawal of monetization permission.

sections.heading: Commercial License
sections.text:
Commercial use refers to the use of the artwork for business, promotional or revenue-related purposes, including branding, advertising, merchandise, packaging, and paid promotional materials.
Commercial rights are charged as a +100% fee of the commission price. This license must be purchased before the work begins and applies only to the agreed usage scope.
Any use outside the agreed commercial purpose requires additional permission from the artist and may be subject to additional fees.
The artist retains the right to display the artwork in their portfolio and social media unless otherwise agreed in advance.
